review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains one theorem, `solution`, plus a header of `attribute [-instance]` and `attribute [-simp]` lines. The file declares no definitions, no `@[simp]` lemmas and no `simp` attributes, so it has no simp interface to review. The only simp call is the local `simp_all (config := {decide := true})` after `interval_cases p`. It closes the small cases p = 0, 1 and 4 and has no effect on any simp set. The `attribute [-simp]` lines look like generated boilerplate that disables simp lemmas from other files. I did not open those files, so I cannot say whether those lemmas are badly designed. I found no justified simp-interface finding that can be tied to a declaration in this file.
